blocks.text: Capacitors bohat se gharelu aalaat (household appliances) mein istemal hote hain, jaise bijli ke pankhe, pani khenchne wali motors, washing machines, fridge, flashguns, computer keyboards aur touchscreens. Yahan kuch ko tafseel se dekhte hain.
Bijli ke pankhe aur electric motors

blocks.alt: Pankhe ki motor ki wiring. Supply terminals N aur L. N ke common nuqte se running coil (coils ka bahar wala chhalla) ghoom kar L tak jati hai; starting coil (andar wala chhalla) common nuqte se capacitor ke zariye L tak. Labels: Common, Capacitor, Starting Coil, Running Coil.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.17: Bijli ka pankha: capacitor ke saath starting aur running coils ki wiring (kitab ki Figure 16.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; tasaveer shamil nahi).

blocks.text: Pankhe ki motor ke starting hisse (starting coil) ke saath capacitor jora jata hai. Bijli ON karte hi capacitor charge hona shuru hota hai. Is ki madad se motor static friction (ruki cheez ki ragar) aur inertia (jamood) ki shuru wali rukawat par qaboo pa kar jaldi ghoomna shuru kar deti hai. Washing machines, blenders, choppers, grinders aur pani ki motors mein bhi capacitor yahi kaam karta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke capacitor 'izafi taqat deta hai'. Zyada durust yeh hai ke single-phase motor mein running coil aur starting coil hoti hai. Starting coil ke saath series mein capacitor us coil ke current ka waqt (phase) running coil ke muqable khiska deta hai. Phir dono coils ghoomta magnetic field banati hain jo rotor ko ghumata hai; is ke baghair single-phase motor sirf bhinbhinati aur chalti nahi.

Fridge aur air conditioner ke compressors aam taur par single phase motors istemal karte hain jo khud se chalna shuru karne mein mushkil mehsoos karti hain. In mein zyada capacitance wale capacitors lagaye jate hain. Kitab ke mutabiq aisa capacitor compressor ki motor ke liye “jump start” ka kaam karta hai aur motor ko ghumana shuru karwata hai.

Jab motor aik khaas raftar (speed) tak pohanch jaye to relay (aik khud kaar switch) capacitor ko alag kar deta hai, kyunke ab us ki zaroorat nahi. Isay “start capacitor” kehte hain. Aksar fridge aur air conditioners mein “run capacitor” bhi hota hai jo hamesha circuit mein juda rehta hai aur bijli ki bachat (energy efficiency) barhata hai. Kuch purane models mein sirf start capacitor hota hai jo sirf start par kaam karta hai.

Capacitor aur resistor mil kar time delay circuit bana sakte hain (RC time constant ki wajah se). Fridge, air conditioner aur doosre aalaat mein yeh bijli on hone mein thori der (delay) daalta hai, taake bijli ke achanak utaar charhao (power fluctuation) se device mehfooz rahe.

Flashgun mein capacitor flash tube ko chalane ke liye electrical energy jama karta aur phir chhorta hai. Flash tube mein xenon gas hoti hai. Capacitor camera ki battery (ya kisi aur source) se charge hota hai. Shutter button dabane par capacitor flash tube se jur jata hai. Capacitor ka tez discharge itna zyada current deta hai ke xenon gas ionize ho jati hai aur tez roshni ka jhamaka (burst) nikalta hai.

blocks.alt: Saada flashgun circuit: battery aur capacitor C parallel mein; aik switch capacitor ko xenon wali flash tube se jorta hai.
blocks.caption: Flashgun ka saada circuit (asal khaaka; kitab mein yeh figure nahi, wahan sirf camera ki tasveer hai).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Battery chhoti hoti hai aur ahista ahista capacitor ko charge karti hai. Shutter dabane par switch band hota hai aur capacitor apni sari jama tawanai bohat thore waqt mein flash tube mein chhor deta hai. Itna bara current xenon gas ko ionise karta hai aur tez roshni ka jhonka nikalta hai. (Asal camera mein voltage barhane wala circuit bhi hota hai; yeh khaaka sirf bunyadi khayal dikhata hai.)
Capacitors alternating current (AC) ko direct current (DC) mein badalne ke amal mein bohat istemal hote hain. Is amal ko rectification kehte hain.
Full wave rectification ka aik aam circuit “bridge circuit” kehlata hai. Half wave aur full wave rectifiers agle chapter mein parhenge.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke bridge circuit 'Fig. 16.15 (a,b)' mein dikhaya gaya hai, lekin is chapter mein aisi koi figure nahi; Fig. 16.15 to topic 16.9 ka charge decay graph hai.

Tibb (medical) mein bhi capacitors ka bohat istemal hai. Dil ka daura (cardiac arrest) parne par capacitor mein jama energy dil ko jaan bachane wala jhatka (shock) deti hai taake dharkan wapas theek ho jaye (defibrillator). Imaging machines (CT, MRI, X-ray, ultrasound) mein capacitors noise (faltu signals) ko filter kar ke tasveer saaf karte hain. Isi tarah EEG aur ECG machines mein bhi na-pasandeeda signals ko filter karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Flashgun chhoti si battery se itna tez flash kaise paida kar leta hai?
blocks.explanation: Battery capacitor ko aahista aahista charge karti hai. Phir capacitor apni saari jama energy bohat hi kam waqt mein flash tube mein chhor deta hai, is liye bohat zyada current aur power milti hai jo xenon ko ionize kar ke tez roshni deti hai.

items: Motors (pankha, pump, compressor): start aur run capacitors.
RC time delay circuits, flashgun, rectification.
Tibb: defibrillator, imaging, EEG aur ECG mein filtering.
